title: Hi everyone! Let me introduce you to "The Shadow of Genesis"
author: Office_Hero_
selftext:
Been grinding on this solo for a while and it's finally live (Link in the comments).

The Shadow of Genesis - is a Telegram Mini App game:  
\- Pick your hero,  
\- Dive into new worlds  
\- Fight your way through bosses, including a World Boss the whole community takes on together.

Built this as a one-person project and I'm genuinely hyped to get this out. Would love your feedback, roast it if you have to, I'll be in the comments.

I used Claude Code throughout, it's not a one-shot generator, more like a coding partner I work with over long sessions: I describe a bug or feature, it proposes the actual code change, I review and apply it.

**EDIT: More on how I built it with AI (per rule 4)**

I'm a solo dev, and I built this working with Claude Code in a long-running session rather than one-shot prompting. Breakdown of how it actually splits:

**How the work is split**

* Me: game design, art direction, the economy (prize amounts, ad limits, reward balance), all playtesting on real devices/Telegram, and every final call on what ships.
* Claude: writes and edits the actual code, proposes fixes when something's broken.

**Tech stack**

* Frontend: ReactJS
* Backend: Supabase

**Where it helped most**

* Anti-cheat on the World Boss mode: players found they could skip requirements for prize-winning, just by leaving and re-entering the fight.
* Chasing down why referral credit was going missing for some invites: traced it through two different code paths and landed on the real cause.

**What didn't go smoothly**

* It introduced bugs while repairing other bugs, that's why is so important to actual know how to code and review it properly
* It still gets things wrong on the first pass sometimes, I catch those by actually testing in Telegram
